nodes.label: STU-05: student homework lifecycle, immutable versions and drafts
nodes.summary: Existing per-student delivery is the resource. Newest-first status-filtered list, text comments, soft deadline, one 30-day draft and immutable submission versions. CSRF/session/role/current ownership and access are revalidated. No numeric grades; legacy textual column retained but new values rejected.

nodes.label: STU-05: confirmed private S3 upload with immutable final object
nodes.summary: One private school bucket on the existing Neon main branch, permanent-origin CORS, sensitive Vercel server credentials. Real storage probe passed PUT/HEAD/COPY, final immutability and unsigned/type/size 403. No extra database or environment. Capability URL signed after DB commit, absent from durable idempotency result, fixed expiry. STU-06 extends this same adapter with authorized signed GetObject reads; prior upload behavior is retained. STU-09 adds separate PDF private create-only PUT, HEAD acknowledgment recovery, opaque fenced keys and fixed ready_at+3600s signature; existing900s upload reads remain unchanged. Real S3 acceptance pending.
nodes.current_summary: STU-11 adds bounded private raster avatar reads with signature/type/size checks; existing homework900s and fixed PDF3600s mechanisms retained. Real S3 remains pending.

nodes.label: STU-05: prepared draft, upload and version invariants
